articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced its monthly Ethereum (ETH) treasury and staking metrics for the month of December 2025.
articles.title: Bit Digital Inc. Reports Monthly Ethereum Treasury and Staking Metrics for December 2025

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today released its annual shareholder letter to investors. The full letter is available on the Company’s investor relations page.
articles.title: Bit Digital Releases Annual Shareholder Letter

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today reaffirmed its long-term investment in WhiteFiber, Inc. (Nasdaq: WYFI) and confirmed that it will not sell any of its WhiteFiber shares in any secondary offering or other discretionary disposition during 2026.
articles.title: Bit Digital Reaffirms Long-Term Investment in WhiteFiber Shares
